 Evan Tan
Operations Technology Coordinator
[redacted-email] | Singapore
PROFILE
Operations coordinator with exposure to software delivery through collaboration with engineers. Seeking an
associate technology role.
EXPERIENCE
Cedar Quay Logistics | Operations Technology Coordinator | Jan 2023 - Aug 2026
Worked with the team behind a Node.js booking service; my contribution was collecting warehouse requirements
and checking screens, not writing production code.
Supported an AWS migration by scheduling user acceptance sessions. Observed deployments but did not
provision cloud resources.
Helped improve weekly reporting; the team reported a 20% reduction in handling time, but my individual
contribution was not measured.
Occasionally adjusted a spreadsheet macro using a colleague's template.
SKILLS
Excel, requirements notes, user acceptance testing, stakeholder coordination. Introductory JavaScript self-study;
no independently delivered software project.
EDUCATION
Diploma in Business Operations | Northbridge Institute | 2022
